name: RAF KT-200 Automatic Electric Kettle 2 Liter Stainless Steel Cordless 1500W with Overheat Protection
description:
The RAF Automatic Electric Kettle KT-200 is a powerful and stylish kitchen essential designed for quick boiling and safe operation. With a 1500W concealed heating element, it boils up to 2 liters of water efficiently. Its automatic shut-off feature with indicator light prevents overheating, while the water level indicator ensures accurate filling. The cordless 360° swivel base allows easy handling, and the BPA-free interior with removable filter guarantees pure, clean water every time. Compact, durable, and easy to clean, it’s the perfect addition to any modern kitchen.
Key Features:
Model: RAF KT-200 Automatic Electric Kettle
Power: 1500W fast heating
Capacity: 2.0 liters
Automatic shut-off with indicator light
Concealed stainless steel heating element
360° cordless swivel base for convenience
Water level indicator for accurate filling
BPA-free interior with removable cleaning filter
How to Use:
Fill the kettle with desired amount of water (not exceeding max level)
Place on the 360° swivel base and switch on power
Wait for water to boil; indicator light turns off automatically
Lift kettle off base and pour safely
Clean interior regularly with removable filter
Safety Information:
Do not overfill beyond maximum water level
Always place kettle securely on base before use
Unplug before cleaning and allow cooling
Keep away from children when in use

Package Includes:
1 × RAF KT-200 Automatic Electric Kettle (2L)
